s: Although the water was icy, Ben reluctantly followed his sister into the lake for one last swim.

pf: Did Ben stay on the shore?

pf: Did the firefighter kick the door open?

s: We forgot our umbrellas, so we were completely drenched by the time we reached the bus stop.

s: Grandpa noticed a peculiar smell coming from the shed, like burnt toffee mixed with old socks.

pf: Did the neighbour keep all the apples?

s: The stubborn donkey sat down in the middle of the road and would not move, no matter what we tried.

pf: Did Maya watch the deer for a long time?

s: The timid puppy hid behind the sofa whenever visitors rang the doorbell.

pf: Did the puppy run to greet the visitors?

s: By midnight the busy market was deserted, with only a few empty boxes blowing across the square.

My uncle lives on a faraway island, but we visit him every weekend.

pf: Do we see my uncle every weekend?

s: It was obvious that the dog had eaten the cake, because its nose was covered in chocolate icing.

pf: Did the queen keep the jewels in the garden?
